overall_reason: Mechanically the canvas is clean (120px head, 42px body, 32px label, 84px margins, one red accent, nothing clipped), but every line is self-describing placeholder and half the canvas is empty, so there is no made content to judge; it reads as a correct template awaiting a post, not a designed card. No AI look family is present.

findings.evidence: About 860px, more than half the canvas height, is empty between the body paragraph and the bottom label; there is no image or visual.
